prompt:
You are Grok, design author for Haeryong. REVISION R1a after rejection: the first UI was generic cards, excessive equal nav and cramped reader. Return ONLY valid JSON {"css":"...","shell":"...","reader":"...","ask":"...","evidence":"...","notes":"...","links":"...","files":"..."}, each value raw HTML or CSS string. Total <19000 chars. No tools/prose. Root integrates behavior. Korean UI; no em dash; offline synthetic data. Attractive calm editorial reading tool, not dashboard/IDE. Light/dark tokens, blue#175CD3, ink#172033, muted#59677A, neutral gray sidebar224px, white reading canvas,16px/1.7 text,32px heading, generous rhythm, fine dividers, line SVG icons. Shared reusable CSS classes: app,sidebar,brand,nav-group,nav-item,nav-bottom,main,topbar,breadcrumb,toolbar,content,page-header,eyebrow,muted,small,button,primary,ghost,danger,chip,good,warn,list,list-row,row-title,row-meta,row-end,grid,card,section,form,field,tabs,tab,notice,empty,divider,reading,article,context,context-head,context-body,dialog,dialog-head,dialog-body,dialog-foot,stack,row,code,table-wrap,settings-layout,settings-nav. [hidden] display none important; every control >=44px; no hardcoded light inputs; responsive <=900 nav drawer/context full-height overlay,900-1279 context overlay; >=1280 side-by-side340px context collapsed default; no global horizontal overflow; long Unicode wraps. CSS must style all classes above including readable stacked phone list rows, modal dark, reducedmotion.
SHELL exact placeholders: sidebar with brand and grouped data-action buttons go:home,go:library,go:projects,go:maintenance,go:archive,go:trash,go:settings,go:connect. main header menu button data-action="nav:toggle", breadcrumb id=breadcrumb, preview badge and theme button data-action="theme", scenario button data-action="dialog:scenario". <main id=main class=main> contains header, <div id=banner>,<section id=screen class=content>,<aside id=context class=context hidden>. use <div class=app> outer. Root supplies native dialog/toast. Include sidebar close button nav:close.
READER content ONLY, not shell: doc title "재시도 중 작업 소유권이 바뀌면", project Podway, version select id=versionSelect v3/v2, page select id=pageSelect index/flow/evidence. controls context:files,context:ask(primary),context:notes,go:versions,review,revisit,dialog:more. personal review span id=reviewState separate freshness. article id=article with concise Korean 3paragraph explanation, code sample, short3row table, interactive button data-action=simulate and id=simulation. compact source information. Don't invent independent reviewer. content column ~700px.
ASK: original context id=askTarget, quote, source select id=askMode, textarea id=questionInput, button ask:retarget,ask:send, response id=answerList. EVIDENCE: exact synthetic revision a82f91c, page/path/citation detail action dialog:citation, authored evidence vs later check, partialscope neutral. NOTES: target id=noteTarget,textarea id=noteInput,status id=noteStatus,buttons note:save,note:cancel; no global saved claim. LINKS distinguish authored/backlink/AI suggestion with actions page:flow,link:approve,link:reject. FILES buttons page:index,page:flow,page:evidence,dialog:attachment and file paths. Output JSON now.

Grok design revision R1b. Return ONLY JSON {"home":"HTML","library":"HTML","projects":"HTML","sources":"HTML","versions":"HTML"}. No tools/prose, under13000characters. Haeryong Korean local knowledge reader, calm polished lists with whitespace, blue accent using shared CSS classes (no styles needed): page-header,eyebrow,muted,small,button,primary,ghost,danger,chip,good,warn,list,list-row,row-title,row-meta,row-end,grid,card,section,form,field,tabs,tab,notice,empty,divider,reading,article,stack,row,code,table-wrap. Minimum44px controls handled by sharedCSS. Use real labels/headings, no em dash. Every button uses data-action. Root integrates real in-memory model/behavior. Directory doc has versions/pages; personal review separate sourcefreshness/lifecycle. Synthetic2026-10-12 data. Initial UI was rejected for generic card dashboard and placeholdertext; make meaningful distinct fullscreen designs.
HOME welcome small, strong continue-reading feature with title "재시도 중 작업 소유권이 바뀌면" and data-action=open:podway. Updated since review2rows, Revisit1row, small import/create data-action=dialog:import/dialog:create. No stats dashboard. Library data-action=go:library.
LIBRARY title/Import/Create, search id=librarySearch and filters id=projectFilter (all,podway,haeryong),id=reviewFilter(all,unreviewed,reviewed),id=freshnessFilter(all,current,changed,unknown). <div id=libraryRows>4 well composed sample list rows with open:podway/open:haeryong/open:guide/open:unknown, version/review/freshness independent, long Korean document title. Root replaces filteredrows. Zero-results container id=libraryEmpty hidden with library:reset.
PROJECTS two meaningful project panels Podway/Haeryong with paths and links data-action=project:podway/project:haeryong/go:sources. scoped result list id=projectRows.
SOURCES project/source header, source identity repo path, current revision, available and unavailable source rows, disclosure/default source mode select id=sourceMode, button source:apply with changepreview. Unknown basis informative no warning wall.
VERSIONS compare last reviewedv2 vs currentv3 selectors id=compareOld(v1,v2),compareNew(v2,v3), preferred version id=preferredVersion(v2,v3),button version:prefer and version:open; changed path inventory 3rows, meaningful two-column diff id=diffBody, partialcoverage notice, oldnote anchor content/button data-action=dialog:reattach, button dialog:importVersion. Do not claim preferred changes continue position. HTML fragments no script no external assets. Output now.

Grok R1c design revision. Return only valid JSON {"maintenance":"HTML","coverage":"HTML","freshness":"HTML","relationships":"HTML","topics":"HTML","drafts":"HTML","activity":"HTML","archive":"HTML","trash":"HTML","finding":"HTML","draftPreview":"HTML","scan":"HTML"}. No tools/prose, total<14000chars. Korean Haeryong local knowledge maintenance app, synthetic2026-10-12 data, notagentjobs. Calm polished white/gray with blue accent using shared CSS classes: page-header,eyebrow,muted,small,button,primary,ghost,danger,chip,good,warn,list,list-row,row-title,row-meta,row-end,grid,card,section,form,field,tabs,tab,notice,empty,divider,stack,row,code,table-wrap. Root handles44px targets+CSS. No em dash. Every button data-action. First version rejected for six identical placeholder rows, wrong ownership categories. Need distinct meaningful states.
MAINTENANCE overview scan button dialog:scan, currentjob/progress id=scanStatus and report header scope2projects+partialcoverage, tabs buttons report:coverage/report:freshness/report:relationships/report:topics/report:drafts/report:activity; body <div id=reportBody>. scanhistory2rows and schedules action go:settings.
COVERAGE structural9/10files vs semantic4/9 separate; unavailablefile; action dialog:finding. FRESHNESS2findings changed source and unknown; same dialog:finding. RELATIONSHIPS authored/backlinks vs suggestions approve/reject actions finding:approve/finding:reject; TOPICS clusters and proposed merge action dialog:finding. DRAFTS ready/updatequeued/stale labels, one actionable draft data-action=dialog:draft; publication separate from approval. ACTIVITY concrete3events.
FINDING dialog fragment evidence scopecaptured base, proposed metadata link overlay, explanatory limits, id=findingDecision;buttons finding:approve/finding:reject/finding:reassess/finding:undo/draft:create. Approve metadata NOT publish.
DRAFTPREVIEW capturedbasev3 and actual proposed2paragraph text, states id=draftState,buttons draft:replace,draft:reject,draft:publish; Publish createsv4 only on explicitaction. Stalebase blocks publish.
SCAN form projectscope id=scanScope, depth id=scanDepth structural/semantic,budget id=scanBudget,button scan:start; Rootprogress.
ARCHIVE id=archiveRows 1 sample directorydoc "초기 연결 프로토콜" data-action=open:archived and lifecycle:unarchive:archived.
TRASH id=trashRows2items removedfromactive/archived, destinations clear; data-action=lifecycle:restore:deleted1 and dialog:purge:deleted1; purge impact must BEFORE confirm. Include meaningful empty state markup hidden. No script no backend. Output now.

Grok design revision R1d. Return ONLY JSON with HTML strings keys settings,general,connection,sessions,projectSettings,ai,maintenanceSettings,retention,storage,backup,about,connect,import,create. No tools/prose <18000chars. Haeryong Korean owner-centric local knowledge reader. Synthetic2026-10-12, calm polished consistent white/gray blue; sharedCSS classes page-header,eyebrow,muted,small,button,primary,ghost,danger,chip,good,warn,list,list-row,row-title,row-meta,row-end,grid,card,section,form,field,tabs,tab,notice,empty,divider,stack,row,settings-layout,settings-nav. Root integrates behavior/44px targets; no script or externalassets. No em dash. Every button data-action. First draft rejected because settings were one-sentence placeholders, invented20MB/extensionlimits, sessionswereagentconcept. Fixall.
SETTINGS left subnav 10buttons setting:general,setting:connection,setting:sessions,setting:projects,setting:ai,setting:maintenance,setting:retention,setting:storage,setting:backup,setting:about; right id=settingsBody. General theme selector id=themeChoice light/dark; font id=fontSize16/18; lineheight id=lineHeight1.7/1.9;button settings:apply.
Connection local endpoint input id=endpoint and status; connection:retry vs go:connect reconnect. Sessions2remembereddevices+temporary session, session:revoke. Projects two mappedpaths/disclosure select; settings:apply. AI configuredprovider Grok sample available, defaultsource mode id=defaultSource,provider unavailable notice example, settings:apply. Maintenance mode id=scheduleMode manual/interval/calendar,interval/time/timezone/scope/depth/actionpolicy; settings:apply. Retention days id=retentionDays + separate checkbox id=autoPurge unchecked; id=policySummary; button dialog:retention (impact beforeconfirm). Storage retainedupload panel id=uploadSummary data-action=upload:resume,upload:pause,upload:abandon; no fixedcapsor extensionallowlist. Backup distinguish lastcompleted vs latestattempt and restoretrial;backup:create/dialog:restoreBackup. About buildmockv1.6.2, browserpreview compatibility, no realdaemon claims.
CONNECT entire view title, remembered endpoint, code comparison6digits id=pairCode, approvalinstructions,checkbox id=rememberDevice,labels temporaryvsremembered; id=pairStatus;buttons pair:request,pair:approve,pair:reject,pair:expire,pair:retry,go:reader. These are clearly preview scenario actions grouped caption "연결 상태 미리보기". Return exact intendedpage.
IMPORT dialog fragment newdoc/newversion select id=importKind, target title input id=importTitle,base select id=importBase v3/v2, mock file/folder/ZIP selection id=importSample, transferprogress id=importProgress, text id=importStatus,buttons upload:start,upload:pause,upload:resume,upload:open; clarify samplepicker once, interruptionretained; actualmodelupdatebyroot.
CREATE dialog fragment rememberedproject/provider/source summary, titleinput id=createTitle, requesttextarea id=createRequest,button create:start; progressid=createStatus/resultopen create:open. No backend or fileoperations. OutputJSON now.
